remarks: Situated in one of Westport's most sought-after neighborhoods, this elegant center-hall colonial perfectly blends charm, comfort, and convenience. Set on a well manicured half-acre lot, the home boasts 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full baths. The expansive great room, with its soaring cathedral ceilings, is bathed in natural sunlight, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. An open floor plan further enhances the home's airy feel, while thoughtful design touches blend form and function seamlessly. Ideal for commuters, the property is just 1.5 miles from the Metro-North station and conveniently located on the shuttle line. Only minutes away, you'll find Longshore Country Club, downtown Main St. with its shops and restaurants, and Compo Beach, offering a range of recreational and social opportunities. This timeless home provides a refined and comfortable lifestyle in one of Westport's most desirable locations.
